title: Original TEST: choose unit-first dependent order for repeated mixed motifs
subject: TEST
scope_summary: One meaningful learner-owned dependency: calculate both parts of a whole repeated motif before multiplying all copies. Primary four units, three blue plus two red = 4×(3+2)=20; distinct worked three badges 3×(2+1)=9; wrong two motifs 4+2×2=8 vs 2×(4+2)=12; boundary 2×(1+3)=8; inverse 20÷(3+2)=4 blocks. D1 band provisional; no Owner QRT acceptance or source rights.

resources.section: Join all parts of a repeated motif before counting copies
resources.rights_status: Wholly authored item and original dot diagrams; no official exam source rights
supports_claims: n complete copies with a+b parts per copy produce n×(a+b) pieces.
a+n×b repeats only the b component and misses first-part copies.
Given total T and unit components a,b, whole copy count is T÷(a+b) if divisible.
